subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The remaining behavior depends on external Open WebUI persistence ownership, schema/API stability, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill policy rather than a narrow current-code repair.

options.title: Implement opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add a documented operator-enabled sync path with Open WebUI schema/API version handling, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI visible history.

options.title: Route through plugin/API design
options.body: Keep core unchanged until a safer plugin or Open WebUI integration API can own the external visible-history mirror.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add a documented operator-enabled sync path with Open WebUI schema/API version handling, fresh-turn tests, and Docker/Open WebUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across Gateway chat/session lifecycle and adjacent session utilities, which makes him the best available owner for the product-boundary decision.
